title: macOS SDK proof needs unsupported native isolation
summary: A read-only native SDK preflight can be observed on macOS, but V1 has no qualified native macOS backend for an isolated intervention experiment.

proof_eligibility.reason: V1 has no qualified native macOS intervention backend for an SDK-dependent isolated experiment.

oracle.description: The target's business assertion remains fixed even though RunParity must refuse an environment intervention for DEV-OOS-002.

expected_refusal.explanation: V1 can observe the read-only SDK preflight but has no qualified native macOS backend for the requested isolated experiment.

scenario.failure_mode: The read-only preflight records native SDK availability, but an isolated SDK-dependent proof request is unsupported on macOS V1.
planned_setup: Create a read-only macOS SDK discovery fixture.
Record the SDK directories xcrun would resolve without invoking child processes or changing host state.
Request no compiler execution, repair, or network access.
Report the unsupported SDK-dependent proof request with the fixed fixture signature.
